existing_rows.q: What did Rania`s dad do in the dead sea??
existing_rows.a: He floated in the water and was reading a book.

existing_rows.q: Why there are no fish or plants there.
existing_rows.a: There are no fish or plants because the water is too salty.
People put mud on their skin.

extracted_rows.q: Have you ever been to the Dead Sea?
extracted_rows.a: Yes, we went there two years ago.

extracted_rows.q: Have you ever floated in the sea?
Have you ever put Dead Sea mud on your body?
extracted_rows.a: No, I haven't! Why would I do that? Yuck!

extracted_rows.q: Have you ever been anywhere below sea level?
extracted_rows.a: Yes, I have. I've seen a jerboa and a gazelle.
